name: Competitive Intelligence
description: Competitive intelligence report analyzing competitor profiles, feature comparisons, pricing, and strategic positioning

sections.title: Executive Summary
sections.purpose: High-level overview of the competitive landscape, key takeaways about competitor positioning, and the most critical strategic implications for decision-makers.

sections.title: Company Profiles
sections.purpose: Detailed profiles of each competitor including company size, founding date, funding/revenue, target market, product offerings, recent news, and strategic direction.

sections.title: Feature Comparison
sections.purpose: Side-by-side comparison of features and capabilities across all competitors in a matrix format. Highlight differentiators, feature gaps, and areas of parity.

sections.title: Pricing Comparison
sections.purpose: Compare pricing models, tiers, and price points across competitors. Analyze value-for-money positioning and identify pricing strategies (freemium, enterprise, usage-based, etc.).

sections.title: Market Positioning
sections.purpose: Analyze how each competitor positions themselves in the market. Map positioning along key dimensions such as price vs. features, enterprise vs. SMB, or breadth vs. depth.

sections.title: Strengths & Weaknesses
sections.purpose: For each competitor, provide a structured analysis of their key strengths and weaknesses. Include evidence and data points supporting each assessment.

sections.title: Strategic Recommendations
sections.purpose: Based on the competitive analysis, provide actionable strategic recommendations for differentiation, positioning, pricing, feature prioritization, and go-to-market approaches.

sections.title: Sources
sections.purpose: List all sources of competitive intelligence including company websites, press releases, review sites, analyst reports, job postings, patent filings, and any other data sources with dates accessed.
